name: Chains Of Reality
detailed_description:
Come forth and adventure through a journey unlike no other, surviving the depths alone, or with your friends. In Chains Of Reality, the choice is yours, traversing through numerous, strangely liminal environments trying to utilize the limited resources available in each reality, until it is inevitably unsustainable. 

UNIQUE GAMEPLAY UNLIKE ANY OTHER

Chains Of Reality has it all; core survival game mechanics, huge crafting, currency and inventory system, immersive adventures, a beautiful storyline, and base building inside of liminal spaces while trying to survive just another day. Maybe its the environment that's slowly killing you, maybe its the lack of resources, or maybe its what lurks out there..

IMMERSIVE GRAPHICS

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Chains Of Reality is a stunning visual experience that'll be sure to cause you to feel immersed within the unique environments found throughout the game.

UNIQUE STORYLINE

Trapped here against your will, unbeknownst of what's to come, you play as the main protagonist who is just trying to make it through another day, and put the pieces together to solve the final puzzle; why we are here. Uncover the mysteries that lie throughout, solving problems on your own while experiencing emotion, character development, and more as you drive yourself closer to the end. Will you end up like the rest, the ones who lose themselves? Or will you manage to be the first victor, conqueror of the unknown..

STRANGE, UNIQUE ENVIRONMENTS

Chains Of Reality hosts a plethora of oddly familiar environments popular within The Backrooms fanbase. Explore strange architecture that scratches that liminal feeling deep within your mind, be at ease with calming forest and ocean environments, or feel unsettled within deep, abandoned, and creepy structures and environments. It's ultimately your choice where you choose to reside in this universe, just make sure its sustainable!

short_description: Chains Of Reality is a solo-driven survival horror game taken place in various different liminal spaces and environments. You, and the optional 3 other players will take part crafting, building, exploring and surviving what harsh depths reality has to offer.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X or Intel Core i5-10400F

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
